author: Poatanfan24 (Commons uploader)
notes: Right-side profile in the cage at UFC 302 (floral shorts, gold title-fight gloves), bloodied nose. Best profile: ear, nose bridge, jaw, right-arm sleeve and the red "K"-and-diamond neck tattoo. Commons lists this as the uploader's "own work" under CC BY-SA 4.0, but it looks like professional event/promo photography, so the licence claim is doubtful. Treated as reference-only until the provenance is checked. Commons gives the date as 2024-07-01; the floral shorts and gold gloves match UFC 302 (2024-06-01), which is used here.

author: Unknown agency photographer (via BJPenn.com)
notes: Shirtless weigh-in pose, backwards cap, three-quarter view of his left side; latest clear face. Shows nose shape in 3/4, cauliflower left ear, stubble, chest script, hand tattoos and a gold chain and watch. The article is from UFC 318 week (July 2025) but the photo is not captioned, and the hair showing through the cap opening is a few cm long and dark brown, longer than the buzz cut he had in the cage at UFC 318, so it may be from an earlier weigh-in. Date unverified.
date_note: Published with a July 2025 article; shoot date unknown (2024-2025).
